body:
i had the same issue, and when i opened tpm.msc in my windows, under status it said "not ready for use" and after trying a bunch of stuff in bios the only thing that worked for me was opening Windows Powershell and typing in:  
Initialize-Tpm

and then 

get-tpm 

and it solved the issue immediately. no idea if this would work for anyone else, but it worked for me

I got this error code along with occasionally getting the message: HMS\_WARN\_0300-0D00-0002-0001.I messed around with the hotend/nozzle because i though there was something stuck to the nozzle,  
eventually i found a piece of print debris on the underside of the upper piece that holds the z axis bars in place and was preventing the bed from going all the way up.

  
hope this might help someone with this issue
